definitions.explanation: A small, discussion-based class or study group at a university, typically led by a professor. The shortened form ゼミ is far more common in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: ゼミナール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゼミナール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{経済学|けいざいがく}→経済学：19376_keizaigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゼミナール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}{論文|ろんぶん}→卒業論文：09259_sotsugyouronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}した→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
examples.english: We discussed thesis topics in the economics seminar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゼミナール⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Professor Tanaka's seminar is popular and receives more applicants than it can admit every year.

notes:
A loanword from German "Seminar." In Japanese universities, the ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧ (shortened form) is a central part of academic life, especially in the humanities and social sciences. Students typically choose a ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧ in their second or third year and work closely with a professor through graduation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a seminar group
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: seminar professor
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧{生|せい}: seminar student, seminar member
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: seminar presentation
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧⟦{合宿|がっしゅく}→合宿：11901_gasshuku⟧: seminar retreat/training camp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧: seminar — the much more common shortened form
- ⟦セミナー→セミナー：11000_seminaa⟧: seminar — from English, used more for professional or business seminars
- ⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧: lecture — a one-directional class, unlike the discussion-based ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧
- ⟦{研究会|けんきゅうかい}→研究会：25416_kenkyuukai⟧: study group, research group — a broader academic group

CULTURAL NOTE:
Choosing a ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧ is one of the most important academic decisions for Japanese university students. The ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧ professor often serves as a mentor and may help with job placement after graduation.
